resources.scope: one prebuilt validation process; compilation and Nix startup excluded

scope: In-process registered Symbolica, HEPKit and RustFlow bindings from one freshly linked native dependency graph. Does not modify or certify a separately installed embedding host. Exercises full massive one-loop vacuum-plus-occupied values and cancellation of raised terms, native decimal-string output, Laurent fitting/refinement evidence, typed invalid/unsupported errors, progress polling, and cancellation during massive two-loop native preparation with the GIL released. Massless flowing input is intentionally still unsupported in this source snapshot.
